title.rendered: Arrow Formal Shirt for Women Filafil Blue–100% Cotton

content.rendered:
The Arrow Formal Shirt for Women 100% Cotton is a timeless blend of sophistication and comfort. Designed for today’s modern professional, this premium women’s formal shirt combines soft cotton fabric with a tailored fit that flatters every silhouette. Whether it’s a board meeting, client presentation, or daily office wear, Arrow’s craftsmanship ensures unmatched style and durability.

Product Highlights

  • Fabric: 100% Pure Cotton – breathable, soft, and skin-friendly.
  • Color: Elegant Blue with a crisp finish, ideal for all formal occasions.
  • Design: Button-down front, classic collar, and full sleeves.
  • Brand: Trusted Arrow formal wear – known for quality and comfort.

Why Choose Arrow Women’s Formal Shirt?

The Arrow women’s formal shirt stands out as a wardrobe essential for working professionals. The breathable 100% cotton fabric keeps you comfortable all day long, while the elegant blue tone adds a touch of sophistication to your outfit. Pair it with formal trousers or skirts for a complete corporate look.

Perfect for office wear, business meetings, interviews, and corporate events, this  reflects confidence and class. Its wrinkle-resistant texture makes it easy to maintain, making it an excellent choice for daily wear.
